triggers.name: lms0723_identity_future_member
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER lms0723_identity_future_member AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF email, is_active_member ON public.members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION identity_repair_private.complete_future_member_side()

triggers.name: lms0723_identity_member_writer
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER lms0723_identity_member_writer BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF id, email, is_active_member ON public.members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION identity_repair_private.coordinate_writer()

constraints.name: match_lineups_match_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (match_id) REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: match_lineups_team_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: member_season_ratings_dupr_doubles_rating_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((dupr_doubles_rating IS NULL) OR (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM dupr_doubles_rating)) = 'NR'::text) OR (TRIM(BOTH FROM dupr_doubles_rating) ~ '^[0-9](\.[0-9]{1,3})?$'::text)))

constraints.name: member_season_ratings_member_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: member_season_ratings_season_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (season_id) REFERENCES seasons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: team_members_member_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: team_members_team_id_fkey
